load_and_normalize_aux: load and normalize auxiliary tensors from a dump path and polars DataFrame into a global aux object
has_aux_tensors: test if a polars DataFrame contains the minimum auxiliary tensors needed for alignment
detect_plugin: detect the matching framework plugin from tensor names and metadata in a DataFrame
load_step_data: load and align all tensor and non-tensor auxiliary values for a single training step
load_and_align_aux_tensor: load an auxiliary tensor across ranks, unshard and align it using parallel metadata
